title: 第十五章 祖师爷在上第十六章 名扬帝都
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始
content_zh:

read2（）;千娇阁包厢内。
自从顾尘风被苏挽月请进了厢房，私下会面。
欧阳财就觉得，这菜也不好吃，酒也不香了。
就连身旁两位作陪的花魁，卖力服侍，他也提不起兴致了。
他心中不敢亵渎的女神，才貌冠绝帝都的苏大家。
居然会主动邀请三少，当她的首位入幕之宾。
哪怕三少是他的好兄弟，欧阳财一时也难以接受。
我和三少并称“帝都二废”，为什么就把我落下了？
难道是我不够废吗？
在包厢内左等右等，终于，顾尘风返回了包厢。
欧阳财急得跳脚，“三少你怎么去了这么久，你和苏大家都干了些什么？”
顾尘风没有多言，只将手中那只，带着美人体香的香囊，在半空扬了扬，淡淡开口道。
“苏大家，果然很润！”
“……”
欧阳财顿时手捂胸口，脸色发白，身躯摇摇欲坠。
经过一阵幻灭后，他由衷感慨。
“三少，我服了！
今后泡妞一道，你就是我的祖师爷了，祖师爷在上，请受我一拜！”
……

同一时间。
顶楼西厢房内。
苏挽月靠在书案前的长椅上，用手轻揉娇躯某处，俏脸绯红，眸中愠色未消。
“这个浑蛋，下手真重，一点也不知道怜香惜玉。
而且不仅粗鲁，还小气！
连一件珍贵点的信物，都舍不得给，还学别人题诗。
谁不知道，顾家三少是个不学无术的纨绔。”
苏挽月满怀幽怨和愤懑。
奈何，本命蛊被对方控制，她也只能受制于人。
如今她伤势未愈，手下也全部丧生，
要找出嫁祸自己的真凶，说不得，还真要借助顾家的力量。
“且先与这家伙合作，找机会夺回本命蛊，说不定还能利用他，帮我完成那个任务！”
打定主意后，苏挽月的目光，终于看向桌案上，顾尘风写的那首诗词。
方才顾尘风在这里，写写画画时，她压根儿没心情去看。
如今既然要和顾尘风，维持艺伎与入幕之宾的关系。
这副诗词再拙劣，她也只能收下。
大不了自己改写一番，再装裱起来。

read2();In Qianjiao Pavilion box.
Ever since Gu Chenfeng was invited into the wing by Su Wanyue for a private meeting.
Ouyang Cai felt that the food was not delicious and the wine was not fragrant.
Even the two courtesans beside him were busy serving him, but he couldn't get excited anymore.
The goddess he dared not blaspheme in his heart was the Su family who was the most talented and beautiful in the imperial capital.
She actually took the initiative to invite Third Young Master to be her first guest.
Even though the third young master was his good brother, Ouyang Cai found it difficult to accept it for a while.
The Third Young Master and I are both known as the "Second Wastes of the Imperial Capital", so why have I been left behind?
Am I not useless enough?
After waiting around in the box, Gu Chenfeng finally returned to the box.
Ouyang Cai jumped up anxiously, "Third Young Master, why have you been gone for so long? What did you and everyone Su do?"
Gu Chenfeng didn't say much, he just raised the sachet with beauty body fragrance in his hand in the air and said lightly.
"Everyone Su, you are indeed very moist!"
"..."
Ouyang Cai immediately covered his chest with his hands, his face turned pale and his body was shaky.
After a period of disillusionment, he felt sincerely.
"Third Young Master, I'm convinced!
From now on when we pick up girls, you will be my Grandmaster. Grandmaster, please accept my worship! "
…
at the same time.
In the west wing of the top floor.
Su Wanyue leaned on the bench in front of the desk, gently rubbing a part of her delicate body with her hands, her pretty face turned red, and the sullen look in her eyes remained.
"This bastard is really cruel, and he doesn't know how to show mercy to others.
And not only is he rude, he is also stingy!
He was reluctant to give even a precious token, and even imitated other people's poems.
Who doesn't know that the third young master of the Gu family is an ignorant and ignorant playboy. "
Su Wanyue was filled with resentment and resentment.
However, her life Gu was controlled by the other party, so she could only be controlled by others.
Now her injuries have not healed, and all her men have died.
To find out the real culprit who framed him, he had to rely on the help of the Gu family.
"Let's cooperate with this guy first and find an opportunity to take back the life Gu. Maybe we can also use him to help me complete that task!"
After making up her mind, Su Wanyue finally looked at the poem written by Gu Chenfeng on the desk.
When Gu Chenfeng was here just now, writing and drawing, she was not in the mood to watch at all.
Now since she and Gu Chenfeng have to maintain the relationship between geisha and guest.
No matter how clumsy the poem was, she could only accept it.
At worst, I would rewrite it myself and frame it.
